metadata.description: The projects and people behind Nebula.

page.paragraph_2: The projects and people behind Nebula.

game.paragraph_1: Super Mario Galaxy is a Nintendo game. Its worlds, characters, music and story come from your own copy. Nebula is not affiliated with Nintendo.

petari.paragraph_1: Nebula v2 is built from the Petari decompilation of Super Mario Galaxy, by SMGCommunity, licensed under CC0 1.0.

thanks.paragraph_1: Nebula uses work from Aurora, Dusklight, WiiCompiled, SMAA, AMD FidelityFX, NVIDIA Streamline, SDL and other projects. Full licences and acknowledgements are maintained with Nebula.
thanks.paragraph_2: The website’s Star Bit model was supplied from The Models Resource; the scenery models and textures were supplied from Super Mario Galaxy. Artwork belongs to Nintendo.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
footer.paragraph_2: © 2026 the Nebula developers. Nebula is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Super Mario Galaxy, Wii and Nintendo are trademarks of Nintendo. Nebula is not affiliated with Nintendo.
